visualContract.layoutPolicy: Native track 4px/thumb 12px and full track corner are reusable visual roles; fixed native 100/140/320px track examples are not runtime widths. Thumb uses native fixed white surface and ring role; primitive inline position, translate, range percentage and clipping remain authoritative. Static edge-alignment fixtures use the equivalent thumb-size/available-travel calculation rather than a misleading center-aligned raw percentage. The hidden native range input remains the actual focus/keyboard control; parent :has(input:focus-visible) displays the ring without inventing a second slider role. This reference uses explicit arrays: raw wrapper creates two Thumb instances for scalar props, a documented limitation. It uses Root format unit=percent so single/range native value text conveys units and source start/end range suffixes. Root aria-labelledby is propagated, but Root aria-describedby is not a Thumb prop: actual Base UI Field.Root/Label/Description/Error context supplies the native input help/error instead. These primitives are explicit caller composition, not behavior attributed to the presentation-only shadcn Field. Both HTML dir and actual DirectionProvider are necessary for RTL primitive geometry/keys. True vertical Slider is forwarded by this wrapper and uses a selected 160px extent. Source stepping, Home/End/Page/Shift behavior, array collision policy, disabled input Tab order, candidate cancellation and separate committed callbacks remain unchanged.
